scheme_name: Grant to Coir Cluster/Societies/Agency Component of the Development of Coir Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant should be engaged in coir product activities.
Members of the organization should be coir artisans.
Applicant should be registered under the Co-operative Act or any other Societies Act.
benefits_summary: Grant of ₹2,00,000 per year for five years for administrative and developmental expenses.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
